# The Finance School India

> Let's Deal with The Wealth

The Finance School India empowers students and working professionals to take charge of their money, manage their wealth, learn practical investing, avoid frauds and scams, and think like a CEO.

## Link Tree & Connect with us
- **Main Platform**: https://finance-school-india.web.app
- **Socials**: Find us on Instagram, Facebook, WhatsApp, and YouTube.

## About Us
Our mission is to increase financial literacy in India and beyond. We provide actionable insights and step-by-step guides on budgeting, investing, and growing wealth securely.

## Interactive Features
- **Free Interactive Quiz**: Available at `/quiz` to test your financial knowledge and receive personalized recommendations.
- **Expert Articles and Tools**: Real-world guidance on how to avoid scams and make smart investment decisions.
